Nodes
Builds, tests, CI, containers and the emulator run here.
A session can start on any of these, and its containers may live on any of them. One marked Hosting only takes containers alone, built on the space's node and sent there; its sessions may make, rebuild and remove them there under Agents may: Run its container. A hosting node not listed here is yours to copy to and rebuild on from the Containers page.

A name may hold @VER@ for the version and * for anything. A repository holding docs/release-notes/downloads.md uses that file in place of this list.
What sessions reach
A session here reads these spaces, code and notebook, read-only; only a session on that space changes them.
Only AerieOS's owner chooses which other spaces a space's sessions may read.
